summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a 6-K announcing pricing of a cash tender offer for up to US$250 million of its outstanding 2.032% Senior Notes due 2030. The tender offer consideration is US$878.90 per US$1,000 principal amount, determined by reference to a fixed spread of 55 basis points over the 4.833% reference yield of the 4.375% U.S. Treasury due August 31, 2031. The offer expired September 15, 2026, with settlement expected September 18, 2026. The company is the issuer repurchasing its own debt, subject to proration if oversubscribed. Watch for acceptance results and potential proration.
